works.title: Local AI Swarm System: Multi-Model Coordination Architecture
works.description: A planned system for running multiple large language models (70B+) locally on a Mac, coordinated as teams to perform automated knowledge management tasks integrated with an Obsidian vault. The user is actively designing file-watch protocols, concurrent-write safety, error recovery, and state synchronization mechanisms to enable multi-AI collaboration.
works.quote: I'm purchasing a new Mac to run multiple large language models as teams to perform work involving my personal knowledge management system in Obsidian.

works.title: Pandemic-Era Economic Support Programs and the Permanence Question
works.description: An analytical reference examining whether temporary pandemic-era economic support programs became permanent policy fixtures. Structured in 7 sections with empirical analysis of automation displacement, productivity-wage decoupling, and task-based reinstatement trends since 1980, synthesizing research methodology into actionable policy design insights.
